[[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

== Enshrined deities ==
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shiotsuchi no Okina}}
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Izanagi no Mikoto}}
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Izanami no Mikoto}}

== Shrine crest ==
* Paulownia (5-7 kiri)

== History ==
The founding date is unknown, and it is one of the candidate shrines (Ronsha) for a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}. Originally only Shiotsuchi no Okina was enshrined, but in the 2nd year of {{ill|Shōtai|Q1324780|qid=Q1324780}} it is said that Izanagi and Izanami were invited from Kumano in Kii Province. In Meiji 9, it was ranked as a village shrine.

== Festivals ==
* Annual festival - {{ill|August 17|Q2827|qid=Q2827}}

* Hakusan Shrine
